tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Near-black, warm. Text and 1px borders on paper in light; the `fg`/`border` source. Also the dark theme's `bg-2`.

tokens.name: ink-deep
tokens.usage: Even darker ink: the dark theme's page ground (`bg`) and `accent-fg` there; text on `accent` in dark.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Lightest near-white warm cream: the light page ground (`bg`) and `accent-fg` on terracotta.

tokens.name: paper-warm
tokens.usage: Darker paper for secondary light surfaces (`bg-2`, `surface-2`), table headers, hover rows.

tokens.name: paper-toasted
tokens.usage: Warmest light paper: press-stoppers, hero strips, sunken wells (`bg-sunken`).

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Foreground on dark: text, borders and rules in the dark theme; secondary surface.

tokens.name: cream-soft
tokens.usage: Muted cream: one-tone-warmer hover fill on cream surfaces.

tokens.name: moss-deep
tokens.usage: Darkest moss green; deep fills and pressed states.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Anchor green. `accent-2` and `olive` resolve here; a per-project accent option (Atlas).

tokens.name: moss-mid
tokens.usage: Mid moss for secondary green fills.

tokens.name: moss-light
tokens.usage: Light moss: `accent-2` and `selection-bg` in dark (4.6:1 on dark `bg`); dark-theme green fills. `sage` is the very-light tint step.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Very light green for tints and fills behind ink text.

tokens.name: olive
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of `moss` (the old yellow olive #6b6b3a is retired). Prefer `moss` in new work.

tokens.name: olive-deep
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of `moss-deep`, completing the olive set.

tokens.name: olive-mid
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of `moss-mid`.

tokens.name: olive-light
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of `moss-light`.

tokens.name: terracotta
tokens.usage: Default accent (Workbench): links' underline, focus ring, primary interaction in light.

tokens.name: terracotta-deep
tokens.usage: Pressed / deep terracotta.

tokens.name: terracotta-light
tokens.usage: The dark theme's `accent`; carries `ink-deep` text (7.2:1).

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Muted purple; `accent-3`; per-project accent (Almanac).

tokens.name: plum-deep
tokens.usage: Deep plum for pressed states on a plum project.

tokens.name: plum-mid
tokens.usage: The `info` status hue (5.4:1 on light `bg`).

tokens.name: plum-light
tokens.usage: The dark theme's `accent-3` (4.6:1 on dark `bg`).

tokens.name: rust
tokens.usage: Brick red: the `danger` status hue; per-project accent (Foundry). Sits at hue ~27° in OKLCH, well clear of `terracotta` (~47°). 7.5:1 on `paper`.

tokens.name: rust-deep
tokens.usage: Deep rust for pressed states on a rust project.

tokens.name: rust-light
tokens.usage: Light rust: the dark theme's `danger`, and a rust project's dark-theme accent. Readable as error text on every dark ground (6.1 on `bg`, 5.5 on `bg-2`, 5.1 on `surface`, 4.7 on `surface-2`). Lifted further above `rust` than other families' light steps so it clears 4.5:1; carries `ink-deep` text (6.1:1).

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: The `warn` status hue and light `selection-bg`; per-project accent (Ledger). Carries ink text.

tokens.name: ochre-deep
tokens.usage: Deep ochre for pressed states and ochre as text on light paper (4.2:1: 24px+ or bold 19px+).

tokens.name: ochre-light
tokens.usage: Light ochre: an ochre project's dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Dusty steel blue, per-project accent (Draper). Not a default: the system is never blue-first.

tokens.name: slate-deep
tokens.usage: Deep slate for pressed states on a slate project.

tokens.name: slate-light
tokens.usage: Light slate: a slate project's dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: woad
tokens.usage: Indigo (after the dye plant), per-project accent; fills the blue-violet gap between `slate` and `plum`. 7.1:1 on `paper`, carries `paper` text.

tokens.name: woad-deep
tokens.usage: Deep woad for pressed states.

tokens.name: woad-light
tokens.usage: Light woad: a woad project's dark-theme accent (4.7:1 on dark `bg`); carries `ink-deep` text.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Aged-copper teal, per-project accent (Apothecary).

tokens.name: verdigris-deep
tokens.usage: Deep verdigris for pressed states.

tokens.name: verdigris-light
tokens.usage: Light verdigris: dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: mauve
tokens.usage: Dusty rose, per-project accent (Bindery).

tokens.name: mauve-deep
tokens.usage: Deep mauve for pressed states.

tokens.name: mauve-light
tokens.usage: Light mauve: dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warm amber-gold, per-project accent (Chandlery); carries ink text.

tokens.name: amber-deep
tokens.usage: Deep amber for pressed states.

tokens.name: amber-light
tokens.usage: Light amber: dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: fern
tokens.usage: Cool conservatory green, per-project accent (Glasshouse).

tokens.name: fern-deep
tokens.usage: Deep fern for pressed states.

tokens.name: fern-light
tokens.usage: Light fern: dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: blush
tokens.usage: Dusty warm rose, per-project accent (Millinery).

tokens.name: blush-deep
tokens.usage: Deep blush for pressed states.

tokens.name: blush-light
tokens.usage: Light blush: dark-theme accent; carries ink text.

tokens.name: leather
tokens.usage: Deep cordovan. Material signature `leather` (with gold metal); only inside contained objects (modals, a featured card, receipts).

tokens.name: leather-deep
tokens.usage: Deep leather, the darkest bookbinding brown (the value the source's materials card showed): material shadows and spines.

tokens.name: leather-mid
tokens.usage: Mid leather for material gradients and panels.

tokens.name: leather-light
tokens.usage: Light leather highlight.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Warm orange-bronze. Material signature `copper` (with patina metal); inline code tint in the docs kit.

tokens.name: copper-deep
tokens.usage: Deep copper for inset frames and rivets.

tokens.name: copper-light
tokens.usage: Light copper highlight.

tokens.name: copper-patina
tokens.usage: Aged copper green: the copper signature's metal.

tokens.name: silver
tokens.usage: Warm pewter (not cool). Ghost and tertiary material buttons.

tokens.name: silver-deep
tokens.usage: Gunmetal: the wood signature's deep metal.

tokens.name: silver-light
tokens.usage: Polished silver: the wood signature's metal.

tokens.name: wood
tokens.usage: Walnut. Material signature `wood` (with silver metal).

tokens.name: wood-light
tokens.usage: Oak / pine.

tokens.name: wood-deep
tokens.usage: Ebony / dark walnut.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Bright gilt, the leather signature's metal: a hint, never a shout. Kept well clear of `ochre` (brighter and yellower). Ink text on it 8.7:1.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: Deep gold: material eyebrows and values on light material bodies (3.8:1 on `surface`: bold labels and figures only).

tokens.name: gold-light
tokens.usage: Pale gilt: metal text on dark material bodies (6.5:1 on `leather`).

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. Body text is `fg` on it.

tokens.name: bg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary background (sidebars, table headers, code chips).

tokens.name: bg-sunken
tokens.usage: Sunken wells and `pre` blocks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Card surface, just above `bg`.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second card tier; dark hover fill.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: Body text on `bg`, `bg-2`, `bg-sunken`, `surface` (12.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and labels on `bg`, `bg-2`, `surface` (6.4:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: fg-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text (captions, mono metadata) on `bg` and `surface`: 5:1 there. Misses 4.5:1 on light `bg-2` (4.5) and `bg-sunken` (4.0), and on dark `surface` (4.2) and `surface-2` (3.9): kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: fg-mute
tokens.usage: Muted text for 24px+ or decoration only: about 3.5:1 on `bg`/`surface` in both themes, under 4.5:1 for body text. Kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline on every card, field and table: ink in light, cream in dark.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Secondary border (ghost buttons).

tokens.name: border-mute
tokens.usage: Inner dividers and dashed row rules. About 2:1 on `bg`: decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Section rules and double-rule dividers.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE per-project override point. Links' underline, focus ring (2px, offset 2px), active tab, primary interaction. As text on `bg` it reaches only 3.6:1 in light: use for 24px+ text, rules and marks. Dark: `terracotta-light`, 7.2:1.

tokens.name: accent-fg
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill. 3.6:1 on terracotta in light (meets 3:1 for bold labels 19px+ only; the source's buttons use 12px bold); 7.2:1 in dark.

tokens.name: accent-2
tokens.usage: Secondary accent slot.

tokens.name: accent-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary accent slot.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success state, always with a word or tick. As text: 2.9:1 on light `bg` (marks and 24px+ only), 6:1 on dark `bg`. Kept as the source has it.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Warning state, always with a word. As text: 2.7:1 on light `bg` (rules, dots, fills with ink text), 6.4:1 on dark `bg`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Danger / stopped state and error text, always with a word or icon. Light: `rust`, 7.5:1 on `bg`. Dark: `rust-light`, 6.1:1 on `bg` and 4.7:1 on `surface-2`.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Informational state. 5.2:1 on light `bg`; 3.4:1 on dark `bg` (24px+ text and marks).

tokens.name: selection-bg
tokens.usage: Text selection background.

tokens.name: selection-fg
tokens.usage: Text selection foreground on `selection-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The big shop-sign treatment: one per view at most.

styles.name: h5
styles.usage: Uppercase grotesk heading; set text-transform: uppercase.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Small-caps label: eyebrows, table headers, status pills. Uppercase, in `fg-2`.

styles.name: p-lead
styles.sample: A workbench is what you make of it.

styles.name: p
styles.sample: Body copy is short, plain, and a little dry.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Code blocks, kbd, HUD numerals, recipes in marginalia. Inline code runs at 0.92em.

tokens.name: sp-1

tokens.name: sp-2

tokens.name: sp-3
tokens.usage: Tight sibling gap; material row padding.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Default sibling gap; button vertical padding.

tokens.name: sp-5
tokens.usage: Field and banner padding; material bar padding.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Card padding (16-24px); `pre` padding.

tokens.name: sp-7
tokens.usage: Roomy card padding.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Group gap; `hr` margin.

tokens.name: sp-9
tokens.usage: Section break.

tokens.name: sp-10

tokens.name: sp-11

tokens.name: sp-12

radius.note: Square. Two softenings allowed; pills only for badges and dots.

tokens.name: r-0
tokens.usage: Default for everything: buttons, cards, fields, menus.

tokens.name: r-1
tokens.usage: A hairline softening, rarely used.

tokens.name: r-2
tokens.usage: Maximum softening, for inputs that absolutely need it.

tokens.name: r-full
tokens.usage: Pills and dots only (badges, counts). Never buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-press
tokens.usage: Pressed buttons and sunken fields; the press state of controls without a stamp.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp
tokens.usage: The signature elevation: hard 2px ink offset on cards, menus and primary buttons. Collapses to 0 on press while the element translates 2px.

tokens.name: shadow-stamp-lg
tokens.usage: Large stamp for material objects and featured panels.

tokens.name: shadow-soft
tokens.usage: Faint lift where a stamp is too loud.

borderWidth.note: 1px ink hairlines everywhere; heavier for CTAs and selection.

tokens.name: bw-heavy
tokens.usage: Section frames, hero, the material chrome spine.
